summary.name: LibreCAD
summary.one_liner: LibreCAD is a free, open source 2D CAD application that started as a fork of QCad CE and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
use_cases: preparing drawings for laser cutting or bending
contributing to open source CAD development
summary.what_it_does: LibreCAD is a 2D CAD application described as feature-packed and mature. It began as an effort to add CAM capabilities to the community version of QCad for use with a Mechmate CNC router, and was renamed from CADuntu. The project states it is free of trials, subscriptions, license costs, and annual fees, and its source code can be downloaded as a ZIP or cloned from the repository. It is available in over 30 languages and provides binary installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with the option to build from source. The page also invites contributions as coders, testers, writers, and translators.
notable: Ported from QCad CE; Qt3-free since the 2.0.0 series
Available in over 30 languages with a translation server
Source available as ZIP or Git repository; can be built from source
caveats: Page notes many bugs and features are still unresolved
